t: This is a $(l:programming/conditions)Condition/$ widget.$(p)The $(thing)Condition: Pressure/$ widget allows you to (remotely) check if the $(l:base_concepts/pressure)pressure/$ of the pneumatic block(s) in the connected $(l:programming/area)Area/$ widget matches the configured pressure threshold.
这是一个$(l:programming/conditions)条件/$组件。$(p)$(thing)条件：压力/$组件可让你（远程）检查已连接的$(l:programming/area)区域/$组件中的气动方块的$(l:base_concepts/pressure)压力/$是否符合已配置的压力阈值。
